explication: Clover is a ROS-based framework for controlling PX4-powered educational drones. Its user-facing workflow includes browser-based block programming and autonomous flight control; other product branches provide ArUco vision, simulation assets, and mobile ground-control clients. The README documents the platform and its capabilities, while sampled source confirms selected block-editor and marker-processing relationships. Several runtime components are represented by their exact source paths, but their internal wiring was not sampled.
